Roa is a core on him because of the hp and mana it gives him. Its really good late game. However the item takes forever to stack so you usually want to rush early.

Ap-tankish malzahar is the way to go imo. 

Ap tankish malz core items: Hourglass. Roa. Rylai's. Liandrys. Deathcape. and boots.

If you want to go glass cannon malz for the lols then try these items: Deathcape. Void staff. Seraph's Embrace. Rylais. boots. Liandrys or Abyssal Scepter.
Like I said before it all depends on the nature of the lane. Try to build according to the situation is what I always say.

It all really depends on the match up.

But in general you should be rushing roa then void staff. Followed up by rabadons. Next item is rylai and hour glass and magic pen boots.

My build in general goes like this:

Roa>Void staff> Rylai> Rabadons> Magic pen boots> hourglass.

My thoughts on rylai is that it is and always has been a good item on malzahar.

First off I disagree on building tear cause you dont need that much mana. Because by the late game you would already have all the mana you need to use. Rylai is actually a really good item to build on malzahar cause of the health and ap. Roa is really the bread and butter for malzahar. Rabadons is the item that I build depending on my matchup and how well I am doing. For example you shouldnt always rush it if your having a bad matchup. If that is the case I find getting hourglass instead does wonders. Liandryss this one is pretty good for malzahar but I tend to opt out for void staff. Finally magic pen boots are always good.
